name: Teh O Limau Ais
hint: iced black tea with lime or lemon and sugar, no milk; lighter than teh tarik because no condensed milk, but the added sugar still counts; variant kurang manis

name: Air Mata Kucing
hint: cooling drink of dried longan boiled with monk fruit (luo han guo) and rock sugar, served iced; refreshing but the rock sugar makes it sweeter than people think

name: Rojak Buah
hint: fruit and vegetable rojak (jambu, mango, pineapple, cucumber, sengkuang) tossed in thick sweet prawn-paste (hae ko) sauce with crushed peanuts; the sauce sugar and peanuts drive calories, the fruit is light

name: Pasembur (Mamak Rojak)
hint: Penang/mamak rojak of shredded cucumber, potato, bean curd, prawn fritters, cuttlefish and boiled egg drenched in a sweet spicy peanut-and-sweet-potato sauce; the fried items and thick sauce drive calories

name: Ais Krim (Local Ice Cream)
hint: traditional Malaysian ice cream, ais krim potong (frozen on a stick) or scooped; variants durian, kelapa (coconut), jagung (corn); coconut milk and sugar base, durian version highest

name: Durian
hint: the king of fruits, very calorie and fat dense for a fruit; variants kampung, D24, Musang King, Black Thorn; people massively underestimate how many calories a sitting of durian is, this is a key honest-numbers page

name: Cempedak Goreng
hint: battered deep-fried cempedak (a sweeter, stronger jackfruit relative), like pisang goreng but richer; the natural fruit sugar plus batter and frying oil drive calories

name: Ubi Kayu
hint: tapioca/cassava; variants rebus (boiled, eaten with grated coconut or palm sugar syrup) and goreng (cut into fingers and deep fried crispy); starchy carb, fried version adds oil

name: Jagung (Sweet Corn Cup)
hint: sweet corn kernels in a cup with butter, sometimes cheese powder, sugar and condensed milk, or grilled corn (jagung bakar) brushed with sweet-spicy butter; corn is fine, the butter and condensed milk are the calorie hit

name: Coconut Shake
hint: Melaka-style blended drink of coconut water, scraped coconut flesh and a scoop of vanilla ice cream over ice; refreshing but the ice cream and coconut flesh make it heavier than plain coconut water

name: Kaya Toast
hint: kopitiam kaya and butter toast, charcoal-toasted bread with a thick slab of cold butter and kaya, usually a breakfast set with soft-boiled eggs and kopi; the butter slab and kaya sugar drive calories
